title: Stacker
description: Stack the blocks as high as you can without letting them fall.
about:
Stacker is a browser game where you stop the moving stack at the right moment and line it up with the layer below. Keep stacking until you win or miss.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Stop the moving stack at the right moment and line it up with the layer below. Keep stacking until you win or miss.
tips: Use click / tap to place the moving layer.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Stacker?
faq.answer: Stop the moving stack at the right moment and line it up with the layer below. Keep stacking until you win or miss.

faq.question: Can I play Stacker in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
